reviewCharts.warning: Virginia review rows use the official ENR all-results CSV for same-precinct President-versus-U.S. Senate screening. ENR precinct display names can differ from the historical contest CSV names; rows are advisory review inputs, not findings.

turnout.notes: Virginia turnout rows use the official VA ENR precinct turnout report. TotalVoteTurnout can exceed presidential votes because it is election turnout across the ballot, not presidential contest votes.

historicalBaselines.warning: Virginia historical baseline rows are official Virginia Elections Database locality-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data. The 2016 locality rows sum 11 votes below the State row in minor/write-in/total scope, while Democratic and Republican locality sums match the State row.
